record.dic_text:
06252 `Ashtarowth {ash-ta:-ro:t'} 或 `Ashtaroth {ash-ta:-ro:t'}

06251 的複數型; TWOT - 1718b

欽定本 - Ashtaroth 11, Astaroth 1; 12

亞斯她錄 = "星辰"
陰性專有名詞 神名
1) 迦南宗教中的假女神, 通常與生殖膜拜有關

亞斯他錄 = "星辰"
專有名詞 地名
2) 在約旦河東邊巴珊的一個城市, 分給瑪拿西支派
   2a) 與 06255 同
record.edic_text:
06252 `Ashtarowth {ash-taw-roth'} or `Ashtaroth {ash-taw-roth'}

pl. of 06251; TWOT - 1718b

AV - Ashtaroth 11, Astaroth 1; 12

Ashtaroth or Astaroth = "star"
n pr f deity
1) false goddesses in the Canaanite religion, usually related to
   fertility cult
n pr loc
2) a city in Bashan east of the Jordan given to Manasseh
   2a) same as 06255
